definitions.gloss: sweeping view; panoramic view; commanding view
definitions.explanation: Seeing a wide area in a single glance. Used to describe looking out over a vast landscape or area from an elevated position.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山頂|さんちょう}→山頂：09942_sanchou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一望|いちぼう}⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: You can see the whole town from the mountaintop.

examples.japanese: ⟦{展望台|てんぼうだい}→展望台：18278_tenboudai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一望|いちぼう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧もと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっていた→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: From the observation deck, the ocean spread out as far as the eye could see.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{最上階|さいじょうかい}→最上階：30428_saijoukai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夜景|やけい}→夜景：10434_yakei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{一望|いちぼう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できます→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: From the top floor of this hotel, you can take in a panoramic view of Tokyo's night skyline.

notes:
Combines ⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧ (one) and {望|ぼう} (gaze/view), literally meaning "one look" — taking in an entire landscape in a single glance. Conveys a sense of spaciousness and openness.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一望|いちぼう}⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧: can see everything at once
- {一望|いちぼう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧もと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: in full view, at a glance
- {一望|いちぼう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見渡|みわた}す→見渡す：07169_miwatasu⟧: survey with a sweeping gaze
- {一望|いちぼう}{千里|せんり}: a vast unobstructed view (lit. "one look, a thousand ri")

USAGE:
Often used in travel guides, real estate descriptions, and scenic spot promotions. The phrase 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{一望|いちぼう}⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧ is a selling point for hotels, restaurants, and observation decks.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{眺望|ちょうぼう}→眺望：20013_choubou⟧: vista, distant view — emphasizes looking at something far away; more neutral about the breadth of the view
- ⟦{展望|てんぼう}→展望：12393_tenbou⟧: outlook, prospect — can refer to both a physical view and a figurative outlook on the future
- ⟦{見晴|みは}らし→見晴らし：15713_miharashi⟧: view, lookout — more everyday and casual; refers to how open and clear the view is from a place
